steps.js: 'whip '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(44);const es=__spawn(1,1e6,true);const E=es[0];const o=[];for(const d of [500,960]){E.home.z=pz-d;E.pos.z=pz-d;E.pos.x=px;E.home.x=px;__sim(1);E.pos.z=pz-d;E.pos.x=px;const h=E.health;__shoot();o.push([d,Math.round(h-E.health),P.lastCrit?1:0]);__sim(40);}return JSON.stringify({o,ammo:P.slot.ammo})})()
